name: Clix Agent
description: AI Agent for Clix - Send push notifications, manage campaigns, and track user events

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: Secret API key for A2A authentication

skills.name: Send Push Notification
skills.description: Send push notifications to specific devices, users, or project users
examples: Send a push notification to device abc123 with title 'Hello' and body 'World'
Notify user john@example.com about their order

skills.name: Trigger Campaign
skills.description: Trigger an existing campaign to broadcast or target specific users
examples: Activate campaign id 550e8400 for user userId123

skills.name: Create or Update User
skills.description: Create a new user or update user properties in a project
examples: Create user with project_user_id 'user123' and properties name='John'

skills.name: Track User Event
skills.description: Track custom events for users and devices
examples: Track 'purchase' event for user user123 with amount=99.99
